name: obsidian-local-rest
description: Community client for Obsidian Local REST API: list, read, search, and append notes. Not affiliated with Obsidian or the Local REST API plugin author.

OBSIDIAN_API_URL.title: Obsidian Local REST URL
OBSIDIAN_API_URL.description: Origin of the Local REST API. Default in the plugin docs is https://127.0.0.1:27124. Use http://127.0.0.1:27123 if the insecure HTTP server is enabled. No vault path.

OBSIDIAN_API_KEY.title: Obsidian API key
OBSIDIAN_API_KEY.description: API key from Obsidian Settings → Local REST API. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. The plugin does not store this value.
